description: The plot illustrates how retrieval performance (MRR@10) varies with the number of queries used during inference (S) for several DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale from 1 to 10, with numeric ticks shown at 2-unit intervals (2, 4, 6, 8, 10). The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with ticks spaced every 0.5. Five colored lines with circular markers are shown: the yellow solid line (“DPR w/ gold”) starts near 33.0 at S=1, rises to about 33.0 at S=4, then increases steadily to roughly 34.95 at S=10; the green solid line (“DPR w/ top-1”) begins around 33.0 at S=1, jumps to about 34.7 at S=2, then increases across S to approximately 36.4 at S=10, with intermediate values near 35.8 at S=6 and about 36.1 at S=7; the purple solid line (“DPR w/ bottom-1”) starts near 34.75 at S=1, reaches about 35.05 at S=3, then fluctuates slightly downward and ends around 34.7 at S=10; the blue solid line (“DPR w/ random”) starts around 34.75 at S=1, increases to about 35.25–35.3 by S=3–4, then stays near 35.2 through S=9 and ends around 35.3 at S=10; the red solid line (“DPR w/ curriculum”) starts near 35.15 at S=1, rises to about 35.55 at S=2 and about 35.65–35.7 by S=4–5, then remains around 35.75–35.8 through S=10. Three horizontal dashed reference lines are also present: a red dashed line near 35.6, a purple dashed line near 34.9, and a green dashed line near 34.65.
